    • startNewDay

      public void startNewDay(greenfoot.World world)
      Prepares the store for a new day of operation. This method creates a list of all product types that can be selected for a daily sale event and then calls the SaleManager to randomly choose one of them. The world reference is passed so that the sale visuals or effects can be displayed in the correct world.
      Parameters:
      world - the world in which the sale event should be created

    • getStoreNumber

      public int getStoreNumber()
      Returns the store number based on this store's name. For example, "Store 1" returns 1 and "Store 2" returns 2.
      Returns:
      the store number if recognized, or -1 if the name is not a known format
